newsitem.title: UK: Next gains as Morgan Stanley rates "buy".
newsitem.headline: Next gains as Morgan Stanley rates "buy".

text.p: Shares in British retailer Next Plc gained two percent on Wednesday as Morgan Stanley issued a "buy" rating on the retail group and set a 12-month price target of 850p.
Next shares were up 16p at 749 by 1059 GMT in volume of 685,971 shares.
Re-starting coverage of the stock, Morgan Stanley analyst Julie Ramshaw said Next's strong growth record was attracting a rating akin to that of blue chip retail group Marks & Spencer Plc.
Ramshaw identified a number of trends at Next such as the opening of new space and the broadening of product categories that made its prospects particularly exciting.
